<title level="1" pfs="Standard">[Air Scamp](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2985)</title>

<row gap="medium">

<column gap="medium" flex="1 1 400px">

A pale blue head and paper-thin wings peek out from the cloud that clings to the air scamp. Air scamps are short-sighted and flighty, even relative to their kin; they are as likely to fly recklessly into battle as they are to whine in terror at a loud noise.

<column gap="tiny">
**[Recall Knowledge - Elemental](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**
([Arcana](/Skills.aspx?ID=35), [Nature](/Skills.aspx?ID=43)): DC 15

**[Unspecific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 13

**[Specific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 10
</column>

</column>

<column gap="medium">
<image src="/images/Monsters/Air_Scamp.webp" />
</column>

</row>

<title level="2" right="Creature 1">[Air Scamp](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2985)</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Medium" />
<trait label="Air" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=527" />
<trait label="Elemental" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=587" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Monster Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=221) pg. 146

**Perception** +3; [darkvision](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=59), fog vision

**Languages**
[Sussuran](/Languages.aspx?ID=111)

**Skills**
[Acrobatics](/Skills.aspx?ID=1) +7, [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=15) +7

<row gap="medium">
**Str** +1

**Dex** +4

**Con** +0

**Int** -2

**Wis** +0

**Cha** +0
</row>

**Fog Vision** The air scamp ignores the [concealed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=62) condition from fog and mist.

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

<row gap="medium">
**AC** 16 

**Fort** +3 

**Ref** +9 

**Will** +7 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**HP** 12
([fast healing 2](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=62) (in open air))

</row>

**Immunities**
bleed, [paralyzed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=85), [poison](/Traits.aspx?ID=669), [sleep](/Traits.aspx?ID=696)

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

**Speed** 20 feet, fly 40 feet

**Melee**
<actions string="Single Action" />
jaws +9 ([Finesse](/Traits.aspx?ID=179)),
**Damage** 1d6+1 piercing

**Arcane Innate Spells** DC 17
- **1st**
[Gust of Wind](/Spells.aspx?ID=143)
- **2nd**
[Blur](/Spells.aspx?ID=28)

**Sirocco Breath** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([Air](/Traits.aspx?ID=5), [Arcane](/Traits.aspx?ID=11)) The air scamp creates cutting winds in a 15-foot cone that deal 2d6 slashing damage to each creature within the area (DC 17 [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Reflex save). A creature that fails its save is also [pushed](/Rules.aspx?ID=451) back 10 feet. The air scamp can't use Sirocco Breath again for 1d4 rounds.

</column>
